name: The majority voted against a [motion](http://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2016-09-15.206.2) introduced by Senator [Derryn Hinch](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/victoria/derryn_hinch), which means it was unsuccessful. The motion related to [Australian Renewable Energy Agency](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Australian_Renewable_Energy_Agency) and was part of Senator Hinch's attempt "[to save ARENA in its entirety](http://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2016-09-15.206.2)". ### Motion text > *(1) Page 2, clause 2 (table item 6), omit "Schedules 5 and 6", substitute "Schedule 6".*
